extracted_information: The web content provides a comprehensive overview of generative AI and its integration with ONNX Runtime, detailing its definition, supported model types, key benefits of using ONNX Runtime for deployment, and available tutorials and demos.

features.name: Generative AI Definition
features.description: Artificial intelligence that creates new content (text, images, audio, code) based on patterns learned from existing data. Leverages transformer models for text and diffusion models for images. Transforms industries, enables personalized experiences, automates creative processes, and opens new possibilities for content generation.

features.name: ONNX Runtime Benefits for Generative AI
features.description: Provides high performance, scalability, and flexibility when deploying generative AI models. Supports diverse frameworks and hardware acceleration, ensuring efficient, cost-effective model inference across platforms.

features.name: Deployment Platforms
features.description: Run ONNX Runtime on Desktop, Mobile, Browser, or Cloud.

features.name: On-Device Inference
features.description: Enables private inference and cost savings with on-device models.

features.name: Multimodal Compatibility
features.description: Works with vision or omni models, rapidly enabling new model scenarios.

features.name: Ease of Use
features.description: Quickly get started with examples and tutorials.
